evidence.observation: Exhaust O2 has climbed steadily through growth, 6.6 -> 12.0 -> 16.0 -> 20.7 -> 27.2 ppm, after sitting at a stable ~5-8 ppm baseline during the ramp
Tube pressure has risen steadily from ~2.97 to 3.209 Torr during growth
Ar flow is steady at ~100 sccm, so the rising pressure is not from a change in feed flow
Temperature is holding at 750 °C after a brief overshoot to 759.8 °C; heater power looks normal

args.missing_evidence: No reference ranges were given for growth. A leak-rate / pressure rate-of-rise test with the tube isolated would confirm air getting in, as opposed to an exhaust restriction. An exhaust blockage would raise pressure but should not raise O2.
